Gains Network is a decentralized platform for leveraged trading of crypto, forex, commodities and stocks. Gains Network operates as a smart contract protocol on public blockchains without a central intermediary. Gains Network relies on external price oracles to determine trade prices and settlement.

Premia is a decentralized options protocol built on Ethereum-compatible public blockchains. Premia offers option trading without a central intermediary, using smart contracts. Premia uses liquidity pools to provide counterparties for option trades.

Barnbridge is a decentralized finance protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Barnbridge offers yield-related products implemented as smart contracts. Barnbridge is governed by its token holders through a decentralized autonomous organization.

Synfutures is a decentralized derivatives protocol offering perpetual futures and options. Synfutures runs its contracts on public blockchains without a central intermediary. Synfutures is deployed on more than one Ethereum-compatible blockchain.

Hedgey is a decentralized token management platform built on the Ethereum blockchain. Hedgey supports token vesting, lockups and options through smart contracts. Hedgey represents its token positions as non-fungible tokens.
